scenarios.hypothesis_summary: Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito entered the storeroom First responder for toner, Mr Abiodun Castellanos entered shortly afterwards with card C-041 to fetch paper, and they argued about a missed deadline. Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito alone shoved Mr Abiodun Castellanos, whose head struck the grey cabinet, then Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito left at 21:31; Mr Abiodun Castellanos recovered, reached the corridor and sat against the wall until found by Ms Clementine Alvarenga.

Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito denied being near the corridor at 21:30 and said Mr Abiodun Castellanos was not with him, contrary to the 21:31 storeroom exit recorded for C-017.
Ms Clementine Alvarenga found Mr Abiodun Castellanos bleeding and sitting against the corridor wall and called emergency services.
